Lone Winther Jensen is a medical director and management representative for the Regional Health Directors' Circle (Regionssundhedsdirektørkredsen) [^src1]. She is professionally affiliated with Regionshospitalet Randers in the Central Denmark Region (Region Midtjylland) [^src1]. 

Jensen serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] [^src1]. Her role on the committee is significant, as her presence ensures regional management and political backing for the database's initiatives, anchoring the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) within the broader interdisciplinary and cross-regional governance structure of the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1].
